title: Decoder floors, closures: punctured E8 units (Model C) to p = 46 (all m) and p ≤ 56 (merged m ≥ 8), windows h = 10–11 (no κ claim)
body:
## Decoder floors, closures: punctured E8 units (Model C) to p = 46 (all m) and p ≤ 56 (merged m ≥ 8), windows h = 10–11 (no κ claim)

**Status: research note, no κ claim.** Closures-only follow-up of #2338 (open; parent): only results that are final in the author's working cards (PROVEN, or CHECKED with drat-trim-verified proofs, or kissat-CHECKED and labelled so). Everything still open or conditional is deliberately left out and listed at the end. Snapshot Oct 15 2026; base 0fdd7d82.

## Results (all puncture statements are **Model C: dense `B`, column-space factors**, any number of terms `m`; any `B` and masked factors untouched)

`m` = number of terms **after merging proportional factors** (PUNCTTHEORY §1(ii)); "all `m`" is unaffected. "Beats P102" means below the `x_{h(K)}` bar: `h(K) = 9` for `p ≤ 55`; at `p = 56` the two 64-line label-hyperplane sets (`h(K) < 9`) are closed separately (E7q with `q = 0`; half-spin `S = D8`, cost `≥ 40 > x₈·64`; PUNCTTHEORY §2.3).

1. **Punctures, RECORDED (cards PUNCT5/7; kissat + drat-trim end-to-end in the cards).** `p = 46` closed for all `m` (`m ≥ 8` by exact integer data; `m ≤ 7` by **571 orbit-tree cubes, all UNSAT-VERIFIED against the unreduced CNFs**, reduction soundness paragraph in the README); `p = 45` closed for all `m` (Theorem 45 + monotonicity in `P`); `p = 47` closed for `m ≥ 8`.
2. **Theorem M8 (PROVEN from CHECKED / RECORDED data): every decoder with `m ≥ 8` terms after merging is closed for `48 ≤ p ≤ 56`** (a decoder with ≥ 9 raw terms merging to ≤ 7 is the OPEN `m ≤ 7` case), via Theorem E7q (`q_α ≤ 9 ⇒ cost ≥ 49 − 2q_α`, any `m`), E7 Lemma G + Lemma R, a root-pair census and a Case-B census (11 leaves, kissat + drat-trim VERIFIED); Lemma H is kept with the PUNCTTHEORY lemmas. The E7 frame hitting number 10 and the clique inputs are re-checked in `verify.sh`.
3. **`f(s) ≥ 7s` for `s = 1..8`** on the P112 coordinate-block punctures (updates #2338 row 9; `s = 2..5` DRAT-verified in a working card; `f(1)` cited).
4. **Windows (root code = Gram realisation, any `m`, any fitting `B` of rank ≤ h).** `h = 10`: every term ≥ 8, P112 ≥ 64: kissat UNSAT verdicts 688/688 (shipped logs, counted by `c4`), DRAT 687/688 (G-queries 46/46 DRAT); the 688th T(10) query is RECORDED (a single kissat run, not reproduced: re-runs at 2,400 s and 1,200 s gave no verdict). h = 10 was already RECORDED in #2338 with DRATs pending; this PR supplies 687/688. `h = 11`: every term ≥ 7, P112 ≥ 56 > 55: **kissat-CHECKED (522/522 T(11), 46 G(11,3)); DRAT NOT complete: 40/46 G(11,3), 0/522 T(11) at the Oct 15 11:3x snapshot** (the resumable DRAT job on the reduced CNFs, RREF / ORTH / GAUGE, each PROVEN sound, is running; only drat-trim VERIFIED proofs counted).

## Prior work and overlap
Direct predecessors on the puncture question, all for **different decoder classes**: #631, #875, #939, #1171 (E8 star label decoders, `63/111`, through `p = 119`; #939 reaches `p = 55`), #1020, #1521, #1180, #1609 (general / one-sided decoders at `p ≤ 27`), #1212 / #1389 / #1399 / #1419 / #1425 / #1292 (rank-8 gauge rigidity, cited where rigidity is needed), #1187 / #1455 / #1304 / #1614 (fixed decoders on P104 / P112 punctures), #968 (P104 unit). None is re-derived. Exact comparison in the package README and NOTICE; no PR found stating the Model-C closures at `p = 45..56`, E7q, or the `h = 10 / 11` windows (text search is not novelty proof).

## Still open (tracked in #2338)
`p = 47` with `m ≤ 7`; `m ≤ 7` at `48 ≤ p ≤ 56`; `p ≥ 57` and `p ≥ 75`; non-E7 non-spanning `K`; any-`B` and masked factors; complete `h = 11` DRAT; rank-9 realisations; `h ≥ 12`; the single-call outside-`col M` floor, batching and mixed units; other P104 units.

## Scope and caveats
Status-only updates to #2338 rows 9, 16/16a and 19a. Results marked RECORDED are results of the author's working cards that `verify.sh` does **not** re-run; it counts the shipped logs (`c4`) and re-checks the arithmetic and clique facts. The cube / census DRAT proofs are not shipped (size). The card texts are live files (pinned by hash). Swarm PRs are cited from their statements, not re-derived.

## Verification
`bash research/decoder-floors-closures/verify.sh /fresh/dir` (Python ≥ 3.11, standard library, one core, seconds; kissat / drat-trim optional, `SKIP` otherwise). On a fresh `git archive` export (single process, kissat and drat-trim present): **37 PASS (2 in step 0), 0 SKIP, 0 FAIL** (5 s); without drat-trim one line SKIPs.
